sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Technical supply crate is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An 8x5 grid technical supply crate that contains Industrial and Electronic items.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: The padlocked version of this crate is never empty. The lock can be shot off.
